controls.held: A human can lend an agent only a role they hold (DELEGATE-ROLE-NOT-HELD).
controls.ceiling: A token never carries more than the role allows (DELEGATE-ROLE-EXCEEDED); a sub-agent token never more than its parent (DELEGATE-WIDENING).
controls.policy: Every call is decided by policy, default deny (DELEGATE-NO-MATCHING-PERMIT, DELEGATE-POLICY-FORBID).
controls.data: Fields the principal may not see are removed before content reaches the model (DELEGATE-FIELD-DENIED in strict mode).
controls.spend: Budgets are cumulative across the delegation tree (DELEGATE-BUDGET-EXCEEDED).
controls.approval: Marked actions wait for a second human (DELEGATE-APPROVAL-REQUIRED).
controls.offboarding: Revoking a user ends every token issued for them (DELEGATE-TOKEN-REVOKED).
controls.audit: Every decision is appended to a hash-chained log.
